claims.sentence: The selection of articles was performed according to the following criteria: (i) articles written in English published mostly in the last 25 years (except for a few historical publications with significant medical meaning); (ii) studies focusing on in vitro procedures, animal trails, and adult human subjects study; (iii) articles whose outcomes indicated glucose homeostasis (e.g., fasting blood glucose level, postprandial blood glucose concentration, glycosylated hemoglobin, IR).
